reason: Antigravity CLI exposes no UserPromptSubmit or equivalent blocking pre-prompt event, and its documented PreInvocation payload contains invocation counters plus metadata but not the user prompt.
transcript_fallback_reason: Reading or reparsing the persistent transcript would couple policy enforcement to an unstable vendor log, occur too late to prove pre-model blocking, and violate the immutable-conversation boundary.
next_gate: A vendor release must expose a documented blocking pre-model prompt payload before prompt_budget can gain an Antigravity adapter. A separately authorized PreToolUse policy may use the existing Antigravity surface without waiting for that feature.
